Logical Operators & Truth Tables • Purpose: Combines multiple Boolean conditions to determine whether a compound expression evaluates to True or False. • Evaluation Rules: - And: True ONLY if both expressions are True; False if either expression is False. - Or: True if AT LEAST ONE expression is True; False only if both expressions are False. - Xor (Exclusive Or): True if EXACTLY ONE is True; False if both are True or both are False. - Not: Inverts the Boolean value (True becomes False, False becomes True).
• Precedence Order: Not -> And -> Or -> Xor (Parentheses override this default order).
